name: TextInput
description: Labeled text input with validation, helper text, and size tokens.

ariaRequirements: clear button carries a per-field accessible name and returns focus to the input
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-26 — production behavior verified in Storybook; argTypes and required stories aligned with validate:components.

label.description: Visible field label; also feeds the input name

type.description: Native HTML input type; tel formats, email validates, and date/time variants retain the browser's localized picker and ISO-compatible value

value.description: Controlled value; an initial "" is treated as absent (uncontrolled), later changes always sync in

error.description: Validation error message; renders above the helper line and sets aria-invalid

disabled.description: Disables the input. Declared explicitly (not just via the native attribute extension) so the agent-blocks prop extraction sees it.

clearable.description: Shows a labelled ×-button inside the field chrome while the field has a value; clearing returns focus to the input

onClear.description: Called after the clear button empties the field (onValueChange also fires with "")

hideLabel.description: Visually hides the label (kept in the accessibility tree); use where surrounding design carries the affordance

usage.description: TextInput is the standard single-line field: label, control, helper and error text in one component. The email and tel types add built-in validation (typo suggestions for common email domains, libphonenumber formatting for phone numbers); error renders above the helper line and wires aria-invalid.

bestPractices.description: Always pass a real label; placeholders vanish on focus and are not accessible names.
Read values through onValueChange; it hands you the typed value directly (onChange is deprecated).
Pick the semantic type; email and tel get validation and the right mobile keyboard for free.
Use helperText for format hints before errors happen (We never share this address).
Use clearable for fields users iterate on (search boxes, filters, generators); the ×-button appears only while there is a value and hands focus back to the input.
Reserve hideLabel for dense compositions where surrounding design carries the affordance; the label stays in the accessibility tree, so still write a real one.
Do not build multi-line entry with TextInput; use TextArea.
Do not layer your own live email/tel validation on top of the built-in one; two messages can disagree. Server-side truth belongs in error after submit.
